leftEvidence.title: The servant pours out his soul, bears sin, and is numbered with transgressors

points.label: Fulfillment
points.left: The servant’s death, bearing, and intercession surround the line.
points.right: Jesus says what is written about him must be fulfilled.

points.label: Objects
points.left: Isaiah’s lines do not mention weapons carried by followers.
points.right: Luke places purse, bag, cloak, and two swords beside the quotation.

payload.posture: Hold both Scripture sources together while preserving witness, setting, sequence, speaker, genre, and stated inference boundary.

rightEvidence.title: Jesus quotes the line while changing mission provisions and hearing of two swords

payload.tension: Luke states fulfillment of Isaiah’s line but leaves the relation between that fulfillment and the reported swords compressed.
payload.title: Numbered with transgressors and the two swords
